source: Sampled from the Symbulator 9 interface, 20 August 2026

colour-dark.note: Added 21 August 2026, matching the Symbulator 9 interface's own dark theme. navy and sky are absent on purpose -- the topbar stays navy in both themes, same as the interface's header.

type.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

roles.accent: buttons, links, section numbers, code-block rules
roles.sky: version numeral in the wordmark, subtitle on the navy bar
roles.amber: warning callouts only - the single warm signal
roles.green: tip callouts - must not be blue
roles.danger: caution callouts, errors, and returned values
roles.lcd: code blocks: a line you type

notes: IBM Plex Serif is for long-form reading only; do not use it in the app.
Callouts carry an icon and a word, never colour alone.
Amber is inherited from the TI-89 keypad and is the only warm hue kept.

Dark Mode (21 August 2026): the website now has a toggle, same mechanism as the interface's -- a data-theme="dark" attribute on <html>, applied before first paint from a saved preference, see colour-dark above.
